breakdown.description: Stokes (creeping-flow) drag is applied at a Reynolds number that is not in the creeping-flow regime.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification directly uses the Stokes drag equation Fd = 3 pi mu D V without checking the Reynolds number or noting that Stokes drag is invalid at this Re (~2500). The ground truth requires computing Re first and, since Re is not << 1, using an appropriate drag coefficient correlation with Fd = (1/2) rho V^2 Cd A. The agent repeated the original error.
